greeting: Hi there, how can we help?
noFaqs: No FAQs found for this topic.
contactSub: Create a support ticket in the app. Response timing is not guaranteed.

f1.q: How do I cancel a booking?
f1.a: Use booking details to request cancellation. The Customer Backend reports whether it was accepted. Provider refunds are unavailable in this app build.

f2.q: What if a companion doesn't show up?
f2.a: Submit an incident report and contact local emergency services if there is immediate danger. A refund or profile action is not guaranteed by this app build.

f3.a: Schedule changes are available for pending booking requests. The Customer Backend must confirm the Companion Backend accepted the update.

f4.q: Are there extra charges for overtime?
f4.a: Session extensions are unavailable in this app build because companion approval and payment processing are not connected.

f5.a: Booking checkout is unavailable in this app build. No booking payment is submitted and no escrow funds are held by this screen.

f6.q: When will I get my refund?
f6.a: Refund transfers are not configured in this app build. If a paid cancellation requires a refund, the Customer Backend keeps the booking active and reports that it could not cancel it.

f7.q: What payment methods do you accept?
f7.a: Card tokenization and booking checkout are unavailable in this app build. Do not enter payment credentials here.

f8.q: How does the SOS feature work?
f8.a: SOS records an event with the Customer Backend. This app build does not notify trusted contacts, share live location, or dispatch emergency services. Contact local authorities if you are in immediate danger.

f9.a: A profile may show a verification state reported by the service. Do not treat a badge as a guarantee; meet in public and use your judgment.

f10.a: Yes, go to Safety Settings and enable "Incognito Mode". Your profile will only be visible to people you message.

f11.q: How do I change my phone number?
f11.a: Go to Profile > Settings Hub > Account Settings to update your registered phone number.

f12.q: How do I delete my account?
f12.a: You can delete your account from Profile > Settings Hub > Account Settings > Delete Account. Please note this action is permanent.
